clue.text: Bowled accurately? That's brilliant!

parts.note: B is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for bowled
right, as in getting an answer right, means accurately

explanation.surface: A cricket commentator cheers a perfectly aimed delivery.
explanation.definitionFit: Bright as an exclamation of approval, like clever or splendid, is a synonym of brilliant.

clue.text: Look for the workers of Smithfield

definitions.meaning: in Cockney rhyming slang '... hook' means look, shortened to the first word
Smithfield is London's historic meat market, where meat traders work

explanation.walkthrough: Cockney rhyming slang drops the rhyming word: a look is a butcher's (hook).
explanation.definitionFit: Butchers are meat traders, as at Smithfield; 'a butcher's' is London rhyming slang for a look.

clue.text: One close to retreat is resolute

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one
close, as an adjective, means near
a nest is a cosy hideaway or retreat

explanation.surface: Someone nearly back at their hideaway is determined.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in earnest is to be serious and determined, so resolute.

clue.text: Food produces a bit of pain in bad tooth

indicators.note: the bit of pain goes in the reworked tooth letters
bad suggests something gone wrong, so the letters of tooth are rearranged
a bit of a word here is just its first letter

explanation.surface: A meal brings a twinge of pain to a decayed tooth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' turns TOOTH into HOTOT, and 'in' puts P from 'a bit of pain' inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotpot is a stew of meat and vegetables topped with sliced potato, a dish of food.

clue.text: Admirer I get on with by and by

parts.note: to get on, as in 'how did you do?', is to do
by and by is an old phrase for later, in a while

explanation.surface: Someone promises a fan they will get along with them eventually.
explanation.definitionFit: An idolater worships idols, so is an extreme kind of admirer.

clue.text: Stood in London borough creating treachery

parts.note: an understudy who stood in for an actor doubled for them
Ealing is a borough of west London

explanation.surface: Someone substituted for a colleague in a London borough, which smacks of betrayal.
explanation.walkthrough: Ealing is a borough in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Double-dealing is deceitful conduct, acting one way while meaning another, so treachery.

clue.text: Slow to embrace enterprise to make milk

indicators.note: the slow word embraces, wraps round, the enterprise word

parts.note: a slow clock shows a late time, and late means behind
an act is a deed, an undertaking or enterprise

explanation.surface: A dairy firm is slow to take up a new business making milk.
explanation.definitionFit: To lactate is to secrete milk from the mammary glands.

clue.text: Taxidermist initially given rotting body part

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of taxidermist

parts.note: high is said of game or meat that has begun to go off

explanation.surface: A taxidermist is handed a decaying limb.
explanation.definitionFit: The thigh is the part of the leg between hip and knee.

clue.text: Old priest's in Haiti for enjoyment

indicators.note: the priest's name goes in the letters for Haiti

parts.note: RH is Haiti's international vehicle registration code
Eli is the Old Testament priest who raised Samuel; the possessive adds S

explanation.surface: An elderly cleric enjoys himself on a trip to Haiti.
explanation.definitionFit: Relish is great enjoyment or zest, as in eating with relish.

clue.text: Entertain European in Italian restaurant

indicators.note: the European letter sits in the restaurant word, so 'in' signals insertion

parts.note: a trat is a short form of trattoria, an Italian restaurant

explanation.surface: A host takes a visitor from Europe out to dinner at an Italian place.
explanation.definitionFit: To treat someone is to entertain them at your own expense, buying their meal or drink.

clue.text: Old statesman in basilica gets sick

parts.note: a basilica is a large church
sick means ill

explanation.surface: An elderly politician falls ill while visiting a great church.
explanation.definitionFit: Winston Churchill was Britain's wartime prime minister, a statesman of the past.

clue.text: Alien conquest turned out to be significant

indicators.note: turned out suggests the letters were turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: An extraterrestrial invasion proves to be an important event.
explanation.definitionFit: Consequential means important, having far-reaching results, so significant.

clue.text: Talk endlessly about love being a weapon

indicators.note: the talking phrase goes about, around, the love letter, signalling insertion

parts.note: to harp on is to talk endlessly about something
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: Someone who never stops talking about romance is said to wield it like a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A harpoon is a barbed spear thrown or fired to catch whales, so a weapon.

clue.text: The Spanish accept suffering of fish

indicators.note: the Spanish article takes in, accepts, the suffering word between its letters

parts.note: los is a Spanish word for 'the' (masculine plural)
an ache is a pain, a suffering

explanation.surface: The people of Spain are asked to put up with the pain of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Loaches are small freshwater fish that live near the bottom of rivers.

clue.text: Look suggestively back in the dance

indicators.note: back tells the solver to read the looking word backwards

parts.note: to leer is to look at someone suggestively

explanation.surface: Someone gives a lewd look over their shoulder on the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A reel is a lively Scottish or Irish folk dance.

clue.text: Unwanted sewers start to shatter

parts.note: sewers here are things that sew, i.e. needles, not drains

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter, so only the first letter of shatter is used

explanation.surface: Drain pipes nobody wants begin to crack apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sewers' reads as drains but means things that sew.
explanation.definitionFit: Something needless is not needed, so it is unwanted or unnecessary.

clue.text: Patsy and son head assault

parts.note: a head is a headland, a cape
to go at someone is to attack them

explanation.surface: A dupe and his boy lead an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: A patsy is someone made to take the blame for others, a scapegoat.

clue.text: Water and ink spoiled clothing

indicators.note: spoiled suggests the letters are damaged and jumbled

explanation.surface: Water and ink stains have ruined some garments.
explanation.definitionFit: Knitwear is knitted garments such as sweaters, a category of clothing.

clue.text: Pilot eats pastry in court

indicators.note: the pilot word eats, swallows, the pastry word, so it goes inside

parts.note: a pilot study is a trial run
a bun is a small sweet baked item, loosely a pastry

explanation.surface: An airline pilot snacks on a pastry while waiting in a courtroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribunal is a body that judges disputes, a kind of court.

clue.text: Entrance of French painter to society

indicators.note: to here means added to, so the society letter follows the painter

parts.note: Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres was a French painter

explanation.surface: A French artist makes his debut in high society.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingress is a way in or the act of going in, an entrance.

clue.text: Murderer one found in prison

indicators.note: the single unit is found in the prison word, placed inside it

parts.note: can is slang for prison
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A killer is discovered locked up in jail.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Cain killed his brother Abel, the first murderer of the Bible.

clue.text: Escaped? Make for solicitor!

parts.note: to make for a place is to go there
a tout solicits custom, so is a solicitor in the literal sense

explanation.surface: A fugitive is told to head for a lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solicitor' suggests a lawyer but means one who solicits.
explanation.definitionFit: To get out is to escape, so having got out is having escaped.

clue.text: A biro's wielded on a synoptic chart

indicators.note: a pen wielded freely scrambles, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A forecaster draws on a weather map with a ballpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: An isobar is a line joining points of equal pressure, drawn on weather maps.

clue.text: Figure it's a month since opening of nightclub

parts.note: Oct is the short form of October, a month
ago, as in 'a year ago', means since then, in the past

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, here of nightclub

explanation.surface: Someone reckons a nightclub opened about a month back.
explanation.definitionFit: An octagon is an eight-sided geometric shape, a plane figure.

clue.text: Trade union gains prominence in school

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, a prominence in the landscape

explanation.surface: A teachers' union grows in influence at a school.
explanation.definitionFit: To school someone is to teach or coach them, so to tutor them.

clue.text: Six-footer keeps quiet in survey

indicators.note: the six-legged creature keeps, holds inside it, the letter for quiet

parts.note: an insect has six legs, so is a six-footer
p, for piano, is the musical notation for quiet

explanation.surface: A very tall person stays silent while carrying out a survey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Six-footer' suggests a tall person but means a six-legged creature.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect and to survey both mean to look over something carefully.

clue.text: In transit, cutting east of Ontario

indicators.note: in an across answer east is to the right, so the cutting word comes after the province

parts.note: Ont is the abbreviation for the Canadian province of Ontario
hewing is cutting, as with an axe

explanation.surface: Someone is travelling while felling trees to the east of Ontario.
explanation.definitionFit: On the wing means while flying or moving about, so on the move or in transit.

clue.text: Barrel to leak drink

parts.note: to ooze is to leak slowly

explanation.surface: A cask has started to let its drink seep out.
explanation.definitionFit: Booze is an informal word for alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Short let arranged for Mavis

indicators.note: arranged means the letters are set in a new order

explanation.surface: A short-term rental is set up for a woman called Mavis.
explanation.walkthrough: Mavis looks like a woman's name but is an old word for the song thrush.
explanation.definitionFit: Throstle and mavis are both old or dialect names for the song thrush.

clue.text: German traps vermin found in the kitchen

indicators.note: the German abbreviation traps, encloses, the vermin word

parts.note: a rat is a kind of vermin

explanation.surface: A German sets traps for the rats in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A grater, for shredding cheese or vegetables, is a utensil kept in the kitchen.
